capabilities: render a color preview next to inline code color values
recognize hex, rgb(), and hsl() formats including alpha variants
exclude code blocks and only apply to inline code spans
adapt swatches to light and dark themes
extras: Theme preview table in README shows swatch appearance in Minimal and Things themes; the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: CSS color values written in inline code are plain text with no visual indication of the color they represent.
summary: Inline code renderer that shows a small color swatch next to supported CSS color values (hex, RGB(A), HSL(A)) in code spans.
